description: This file is an HTML document serving as a CodeMirror editor for Haskell source code, specifically for the Haskell 'uniquePerms' function module. methods.name: uniquePerms
methods.description: Calculates all unique permutations of a list, allowing duplicates, by using a bag data structure.

methods.name: makeBag
methods.description: Converts a list into a Bag, a collection of element-count pairs.

methods.name: permBag
methods.description: Generates all permutations of a Bag by recursively selecting elements.

methods.name: oneOfEach
methods.description: Helper function that returns each unique element from the Bag paired with its remaining count.
